g.text: LLD 3 / 3 — SERVICE CONTRACTS + RECOVERY
Typed calls • transaction ownership • retries • SQLite connection model
ADAPTER → COORDINATOR → VERIFIER
# Typed boundary (Python-style)
SwitchAdapter.ingest(event: SwitchEvent)
-> InboxReceipt(event_key, duplicate, state, result?)
Transaction: INSERT inbox + advance received cursor.
Coordinator.process(event: InboxEvent)
-> CommandResult(status, task_id?, reply, retry_at?)
No transaction of its own. Resolve trusted Switch ID +
active room membership;
room lead authority is scoped to this Switch room.
Parse/validate command; call repository + verifier.
TaskRepository.start_attempt(cmd: StartAttempt)
-> AttemptSnapshot(attempt_id, task_version,
policy_revision, policy_hash, pr_url)
Short transaction: create attempt + update task proof
status/version + audit event.
GitHubVerifier.verify(input: VerificationInput)
-> VerifiedSnapshot | RetryableFailure | PermanentFailure
Read-only GitHub calls; no DB writes, no GitHub writes.
Input includes task scope, trusted owner/delegates,
policy snapshot and captured head SHA when rechecking.
REPOSITORY → ATOMIC COMPLETION
TaskRepository.finalize_success(
result: VerifiedSnapshot, inbox_key: InboxKey)
-> CommitResult(COMMITTED | CONFLICT | INELIGIBLE)
Repository owns ONE short BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction:
1. CAS task version/status/proof/active attempt.
2. Check policy head revision + hash in SQL.
3. Check attempt still CHECKING and active.
4. On success, update task + attempt; insert SHA proof;
append task event; insert outbox; save inbox result DONE.
5. Commit. Zero-row CAS means rollback everything.
TaskRepository.record_retry(...)
-> AttemptResult(PENDING_RETRY | SUPERSEDED)
TaskRepository.record_rejection(...)
-> AttemptResult(REJECTED)
Each uses a short transaction and conditional attempt ID.
Coordinator reloads and reauthorizes after conflict; it
never writes task/proof tables directly.
INBOX ORDER + CURSOR RECOVERY
States: RECEIVED → PROCESSING → DONE or ERROR_TERMINAL.
Transient internal processing failure → RETRY with next_retry_at; claim lease is 60s with a 20s
heartbeat. Retry up to 8 times, then ERROR_TERMINAL + alert. A handled GitHub timeout is
different: inbox becomes DONE with “proof pending”; the attempt row schedules its own retry.
On ingest, one transaction inserts the event under UNIQUE(room_id,event_id) and updates
received_cursor. Duplicate delivery returns the saved result if terminal; pending duplicates
return
“already received.”
received_cursor = latest provider cursor durably stored.
processed_cursor = latest cursor whose entire earlier FIFO prefix is DONE or ERROR_TERMINAL.
Cursors are opaque; local arrival_seq orders events. One room processes serially; different rooms
may run concurrently.
Reconnect resumes after received_cursor, then drains local RECEIVED/RETRY rows. If cursor expired,
backfill room history and rely on unique event IDs. Adapter contract requires stable event IDs and
resumable cursor/history; without provider support, lossless recovery cannot be promised.
OUTBOX LEASE + DELIVERY
Outbox states: READY → CLAIMED → SENT or DEAD.
Claim transaction picks due READY rows or CLAIMED rows with expired lease; writes random
claim_token, lease_until=now+60s, attempts=attempts+1. Post to Switch outside transaction. Ack
updates SENT only when claim_token still matches.
Retry: max 8 attempts. Full-jitter exponential backoff: random(0, min(5s × 2^(attempt−1), 15m)).
After attempt 8, DEAD + alert lead. Permanent auth/config errors go DEAD immediately. Manual
replay
is audited and uses a new idempotency key.
Crash before post: lease expires and another worker reclaims. Remote accepted post + lost ack:
retry may duplicate; at-least-once delivery is explicit. Completion/outbox insertion remains
exactly once internally via UNIQUE(idempotency_key).
ERROR TYPES → ACTION
AuthorizationDenied
Save terminal inbox result; no task mutation; no retry.
PermanentProofFailure (repo/author/path/check failed)
Attempt REJECTED; task stays open; explain correction.
GitHubTransient (timeout, 429, 5xx)
Attempt RETRY_LATER; persist inbox DONE with a pending result; scheduled backoff/webhook retry.
GitHub 403/404 or invalid credentials/repo access
Fail closed; actionable terminal error; retry only after config changes.
SnapshotChanged (head/check/rerun changed)
Supersede attempt; start a new attempt from fresh reads.
CASConflict (task or policy changed)
Roll back all final writes; reload + reauthorize + reverify.
StoreBusy / SQLITE_BUSY
Retry short DB transaction with bounded jitter; never
repeat GitHub work unless its snapshot went stale.
SwitchTransient (network/5xx)
Outbox retry. SwitchPermanent (auth/config 4xx)
DEAD + operator alert.
ASYNC LOOPS + SQLITE OWNERSHIP
One Python process runs three loops: Switch event reader, retry/reminder scheduler, outbox worker.
No external queue in demo.
Connections: each coroutine owns its aiosqlite connection; never share one connection concurrently.
Read connections use query_only=ON. Enable WAL, synchronous=FULL, foreign_keys=ON,
busy_timeout=5000ms. FULL means committed inbox/cursor
writes survive process crash and power loss when storage
honors fsync; it costs some write latency. Serialize
in-process writes with one asyncio write lock; SQLite still arbitrates the single writer across
processes.
All writes go through repository methods. Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE; keep transactions under 100ms; no
GitHub or Switch network call inside a transaction. If SQLITE_BUSY persists past bounded retries,
leave durable inbox/outbox work pending and alert; do not lose the event.
Run one app process for SQLite. Move to PostgreSQL before multi-instance deployment; keep the same
repository interface.
